dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: What sharp eyes you have, my good guest! Let me tell you, I'm renowned throughout the harbor as a tour guide. Why, just saying the name "Ratimir" is liable to get you two thumbs up from the local kids!

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: Ask anyone, and they'll tell you that you can't just walk around willy-nilly in Nod-Krai. If you want to get somewhere, and you want to get there safe, you need someone who knows the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Ratimir
dialogues.text: That means a local familiar with the land, who can arrange your itinerary for you. And what do you know, I just happen to be that trustworthy local...
